subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the open fork pull request at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/289, or close/ignore it and sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the current direct Anthropic transport path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the linked fork PR is conflicting and targets old runner files while prior same-repository attempts were closed unmerged; automation should not queue a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
options.body: Close or ignore the stale fork candidate and land a focused patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression tests for direct Anthropic OAuth with model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer bring the fork change into the main repository, update it for the active direct transport path, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open without a new repair lane until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the stale fork candidate and land a focused patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression tests for direct Anthropic OAuth with model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining defect sits in the direct Anthropic transport and endpoint-classification boundary that Vincent Koc introduced and has recently maintained.
